given: a stock record already exists for a given SKU at a given location
when: a warehouse operator files the same SKU at the same location again with a different quantity
then: the existing record is updated in place with the new quantity, exactly one record for that (SKU, location) pair exists, no duplicate record is created, and no error page is shown

independence.rationale: Covers the write-collision path on the (SKU, location) key, an outcome independently breakable from the first-write of AC1: a build could persist a first record correctly yet store a duplicate (or error) on a repeat file for the same pair.

architectural_notes: API boundary (app/routes/) POST that exercises the write-collision path. The Stock service (app/services/) resolves the collision as a single atomic upsert (PI4-refile-upsert-atomic) in the repository (app/repositories/), guarded by the composite unique constraint on (sku, location) (PI1). Transaction ownership sits in the service layer, never the domain model. The 'no error page is shown' clause reinforces the boundary contract: a legitimate refile is a success response, not a validation/uniqueness error — distinct from the invalid-payload rejection owned by NFR-F1-validation-messages on AC1.
